```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource/maple-mono@5.2.5/index.min.css">

<style>
.url1-outer {
  width: 100%;
  margin: 1em 0;
  border: 1.5px solid #5654A2;
  border-radius: 14px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.url1-header {
  background: #5654A2;
  padding: 10px 16px;
  font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 0.85em;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #F8F7F0;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
/* Desktop: plain text full-bar */
.url1-full-bar {
  padding: 12px 16px;
  font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 0.88em;
  color: #564232;
  background: #F8F7F0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
  word-break: break-all;
}
/* Stacked: chip+separator full-bar */
.url1-full-bar-chips {
  display: none;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2px;
  padding: 10px 16px;
  background: #F8F7F0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
}
.url1-full-chip {
  font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 0.82em;
  padding: 3px 9px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.url1-full-chip-base  { background: #EEEDF8; color: #5654A2; border: 1px solid #C4C3E8; }
.url1-full-chip-param { background: #EBF5FB; color: #2471A3; border: 1px solid #A9CCE3; }
.url1-full-sep {
  font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 0.82em;
  color: #B0A8C0;
  padding: 0 1px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.url1-breakdown {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: nowrap;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 16px;
  background: #F8F7F0;
}
.url1-mobile { display: none; }
.url1-stacked .url1-full-bar { display: none; }
.url1-stacked .url1-full-bar-chips { display: flex; }
.url1-stacked .url1-breakdown { display: none; }
.url1-stacked .url1-mobile { display: block; }
.url1-chunk {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.url1-chip {
  font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 0.82em;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.url1-chip-base  { background: #EEEDF8; color: #5654A2; border: 1px solid #C4C3E8; }
.url1-chip-param { background: #EBF5FB; color: #2471A3; border: 1px solid #A9CCE3; }
.url1-lbl {
  font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 0.7em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  color: #9B8EA0;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.url1-sep {
  font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 0.88em;
  color: #B0A8C0;
  padding: 4px 2px 0;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
/* Mobile vertical table */
.url1-m-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 36% 1fr;
  border-top: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
  background: #F8F7F0;
}
.url1-m-label {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 0.8em;
  color: #5654A2;
  background: #EEEDF8;
  border-right: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
}
.url1-m-val {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 10px 14px;
}
</style>

<div class="url1-outer">
  <div class="url1-header">URL Anatomy</div>

  <!-- Desktop: plain text -->
  <div class="url1-full-bar">https://www.google.com/?id_a=xxx&amp;id_b=xxx&amp;id_c=xxx</div>

  <!-- Stacked: chips + separators -->
  <div class="url1-full-bar-chips">
    <span class="url1-full-chip url1-full-chip-base">https://www.google.com</span>
    <span class="url1-full-sep">/?</span>
    <span class="url1-full-chip url1-full-chip-param">id_a=xxx</span>
    <span class="url1-full-sep">&amp;</span>
    <span class="url1-full-chip url1-full-chip-param">id_b=xxx</span>
    <span class="url1-full-sep">&amp;</span>
    <span class="url1-full-chip url1-full-chip-param">id_c=xxx</span>
  </div>

  <div class="url1-breakdown">
    <div class="url1-chunk">
      <div class="url1-chip url1-chip-base">https://www.google.com</div>
      <div class="url1-lbl">Base URL</div>
    </div>
    <div class="url1-sep">/?</div>
    <div class="url1-chunk">
      <div class="url1-chip url1-chip-param">id_a=xxx</div>
      <div class="url1-lbl">Parameter</div>
    </div>
    <div class="url1-sep">&amp;</div>
    <div class="url1-chunk">
      <div class="url1-chip url1-chip-param">id_b=xxx</div>
      <div class="url1-lbl">Parameter</div>
    </div>
    <div class="url1-sep">&amp;</div>
    <div class="url1-chunk">
      <div class="url1-chip url1-chip-param">id_c=xxx</div>
      <div class="url1-lbl">Parameter</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="url1-mobile">
    <div class="url1-m-row">
      <div class="url1-m-label">Base URL</div>
      <div class="url1-m-val"><span class="url1-chip url1-chip-base" style="white-space:normal;word-break:break-all;">https://www.google.com</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="url1-m-row">
      <div class="url1-m-label">Parameter</div>
      <div class="url1-m-val"><span class="url1-chip url1-chip-param">id_a=xxx</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="url1-m-row">
      <div class="url1-m-label">Parameter</div>
      <div class="url1-m-val"><span class="url1-chip url1-chip-param">id_b=xxx</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="url1-m-row">
      <div class="url1-m-label">Parameter</div>
      <div class="url1-m-val"><span class="url1-chip url1-chip-param">id_c=xxx</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function() {
  var outer = document.currentScript.previousElementSibling;
  var breakdown = outer.querySelector('.url1-breakdown');
  var observer = new ResizeObserver(function() {
    outer.classList.remove('url1-stacked');
    if (breakdown.scrollWidth > breakdown.clientWidth + 1) {
      outer.classList.add('url1-stacked');
    }
  });
  observer.observe(outer);
})();
</script>
```
